user.title: Connect to Split Pro
user.description: Needs a Split Pro build with the REST API (`/api/v1`).

data_description.url: Split Pro's address, e.g. https://splitpro.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:3000.
data_description.api_key: A secret from the API_KEYS setting on the Split Pro server (the part after `email:`).
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate.

sensors.title: Balance sensors
sensors.description: Choose which balance sensors to create. Positive means you're owed. A sensor is unavailable while its balance is in more than one currency. Expenses can be added to any group or friend whether or not it has a sensor.

data_description.group_balances: A balance sensor for each group chosen.
data_description.friend_balances: A balance sensor for each friend chosen.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: Split Pro at {url} rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

data_description.api_key: A secret from the API_KEYS setting on the Split Pro server (the part after `email:`).

data_description.url: Split Pro's address, e.g. https://splitpro.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:3000.
data_description.api_key: A secret from the API_KEYS setting on the Split Pro server (the part after `email:`).
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Split Pro's REST API at that URL. Check the address, and that it's a build with the API.
error.invalid_auth: Split Pro rejected the API key.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This Split Pro account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That API key belongs to a different Split Pro user.

init.title: Balance sensors
init.description: Choose which balance sensors to create. Positive means you're owed. A sensor is unavailable while its balance is in more than one currency. Expenses can be added to any group or friend whether or not it has a sensor.

data_description.group_balances: A balance sensor for each group chosen.
data_description.friend_balances: A balance sensor for each friend chosen.

abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Split Pro to list groups and friends.

options.default: Default (the group's or friend's saved split, else equal)

add_expense.name: Add expense
add_expense.description: Adds an expense to a Split Pro group, or with a friend. Target one group or friend device. Returns the expense id and each person's share.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Currency code, e.g. GBP. Defaults to the group's default currency, then yours, then GBP.

paid_by.name: Paid by
paid_by.description: Who paid: a member's name, email or user id. Defaults to you.

split.name: Split
split.description: How to divide it. Default uses the group's or friend's saved default split, or splits equally.

participants.name: Participants
participants.description: For an equal split: who's included (names, emails or user ids). Defaults to everyone.

shares.name: Shares
shares.description: For percentages, shares or exact amounts: each person and their value, e.g. {"Alex": 60, "Sam": 40}. People left out pay nothing.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

settle_up.name: Settle up
settle_up.description: Records a payment between two people in a group, or between you and a friend.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Currency code. Defaults to the group's default currency, then yours, then GBP.

payer.name: Payer
payer.description: Who paid: a name, email or user id. Defaults to you.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.description: Who received it. Required for a group; for a friend it defaults to the other person.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Updates the Split Pro balance sensors now.

unknown_target.message: Choose one Split Pro group or friend as the target.

not_loaded.message: That Split Pro account isn't loaded.

ambiguous_member.message: More than one person in {target} matches {who}; use their email or user id.

unknown_currency.message: {currency} isn't a currency Split Pro knows.

too_many_decimals.message: {amount} has too many decimal places for {currency}.

too_precise.message: The {what} can have at most two decimal places.

shares_required.message: A {split} split needs shares: each person and their value.

shares_not_used.message: Shares are only used with a percentage, shares or exact split.

participants_only_equal.message: Participants are only used with an equal split; for the others, list people in shares.

amount_not_positive.message: The amount must be more than zero.

no_participants.message: No one is included in the split.

nothing_owed.message: With that split no one owes anything (the payer covers only themselves).

percentages_not_100.message: The percentages add up to {total}%, not 100%.

exact_not_total.message: The exact amounts add up to {total}, not the expense's {amount}.

unsupported_split.message: The saved default split ({split}) isn't supported; choose a split.

settle_same_person.message: The payer and recipient are the same person.

rejected.message: Split Pro refused the expense for {target}: {message}
